subject: Prep: technical deep dive — align availability, attendees, and bridge
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@medstream.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Prep: technical deep dive — align availability, attendees, and bridge

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap: you’re evaluating inference for MedStream’s anonymized clinical search pipeline. Key constraints are 75ms p99 for short queries, HIPAA-ready private deployment, and predictable monthly throughput pricing.
- Next step: 60–90 minute technical deep dive with engineering + infra to validate network, data flows, and ops runbook.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Thurs 3/18, 10:00–11:30 
- Fri 3/19, 13:00–14:30

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will join (eng, security, procurement)? We’ll send a calendar invite and include a persistent Meet/Zoom bridge and a short agenda. I’m attaching a one-page mutual action plan and a draft agenda so you can share internally.

Attachments: MAP-Helix-Phase1.pdf (mutual action plan), deepdive-agenda.docx

If neither works, send me two times that do and we’ll adapt.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0122

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@medstream.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prep: technical deep dive — align availability, attendees, and bridge

Ben —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. Both look helpful. Our initial availability: Thurs 3/18 10:00 PST works best. Attendees from our side: Samir (infra lead), Priya Rao (security, copying separately if she accepts), and I’ll loop in procurement after the call.

Quick Q: we prefer Google Meet for internal compliance reasons — is that okay? Also if you can add a short bullet in the agenda about network egress patterns and KMS integrations, that would be ideal.

I’ll wait for the invite.

— Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Director of Platform, MedStream
alicia.gomez@medstream.com | (617) 555-9310

Alicia —

Perfect — locking Thurs 3/18 10:00–11:30 PST. We’ll use Google Meet. I’ve updated the agenda to add a 15-minute section for KMS/HSM and egress patterns. 

High level attendee plan from our side:
- Ben Carter (AE) — product fit & MAP review
- Marissa Cole (Solutions Eng) — demo host + architecture walkthrough
- Connor O'Brien (Infra Eng) — network, VPC/connectivity, and deployment options

I’ll send the calendar invite now (with Meet link) and include the MAP and agenda as attachments. If Priya joins, we’ll be ready to cover SOC2 and key management.

Also linking our short pre-read on private deployments in case Samir wants it early: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-deepdive-agenda

Thanks — see you Thursday.

— Ben

[Calendar invite sent]

Hello all —

Invite confirmed: 2027-03-18 10:00–11:30 PST (60–90 buffer). Meet link: https://meet.google.com/rwd-infer-helix (passcode: 4829).

Agenda (short):
1) 5m — Intros & objectives
2) 25m — Architecture walkthrough (Marissa)
3) 20m — Network / deployment options (Connor) — VPC peering, egress, load patterns
4) 15m — KMS/HSM & compliance considerations
5) 10m — Mutual action plan and next milestones

Attachments included on the invite: MAP-Helix-Phase1.pdf, deepdive-agenda.docx

Internal note to Marissa & Connor: please be ready to show the latency profile on small queries (p50/p95/p99) and the autoscale behavior under burst. I’ll share the invite with procurement after the call.

Ben
